svg.aria-label: Janat Yasser. I build machine-learning systems, then check whether their numbers hold up on data they've never seen. Figure: on HAM10000, a model validated on a leaky image-level split scored 0.858 on validation and 0.727 on the official test set; split by lesion, 0.790 and 0.744.
svg.title: Janat Yasser. I build machine-learning systems, then check whether their numbers hold up on data they've never seen. Figure: on HAM10000, a model validated on a leaky image-level split scored 0.858 on validation and 0.727 on the official test set; split by lesion, 0.790 and 0.744.
svg.text: I build machine-learning systems, then check
whether their numbers hold up on data they've never seen.
Fig. 1. HAM10000 skin lesions. With photos of the same mole on both sides
of the split, validation flattered the model by 13 points. The official
test set didn't. Split by lesion, the drop was under 5.
